item.title: LOT-087: check the message menu policy on an own post of a public topic (#330)
item.body:
Closes #330
Refs #179
Claim: mac/m2-lead

Review of LOT-087 (message actions menu) against the own-post captures. #273 itself is closed by PR #474, not by this PR; the fixtures used are `R63a` and `R63e` (own public topic, logged in, 12 posts, posts 1, 6 and 9 are the viewer's).

**Problem.** The menu rules for one's own post on a public topic were legacy's, with no capture to check them.

**Finding.** The captures confirm the policy, no behaviour change (so no CHANGELOG-LEGACY row). Own posts: edit (same `md_noclass_cryptlink` span, numeric `cat`, no `cat=prive`), plain "Edition rapide" link, quote, multi-quote, `addflag`, `modo.php`; no MP, no contact link. Others' posts: MP, contact, favourite, alert, no edit. The alert link is printed on one's own post but the policy keeps hiding "Alerter" there (legacy `!isOwnMessage`); the test pins that.

**Change.** `MessageMenuOwnPostCaptureTests` (both captures) reads the toolbars through `LiveTopicPageSource.parse` / LOT-031's parser, then runs `MessageMenuPolicy`: parsed links, message menu of own posts (first post without Supprimer), of others' posts, and the author menu. LOT-087 and LOT-031 specs ("Pending capture") and HFR-PROTOCOL §6c updated.

**Tests, shown to fail** (temporary source edits, reverted): dropping `favorite` fails the own-post and other-post tests; offering "Alerter" on one's own post fails the own-post test; offering the lists on one's own post fails the author-menu test. Offering MP on an own post is not observable: the capture has no MP link there, so the parser gives nil (equivalent mutation). Local run on a simulator clone: new suite and `MessageMenuPolicyTests` pass.

+import Foundation

+import Testing

+/// Review #330 of LOT-087 against the captures `R63a` and `R63e` (the viewer's own topic, public, logged in): the menu policy
